title: (Pwn2Own) Kenwood DNR1007XR startUpdateProcess Command Injection Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows physically present attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Kenwood DNR1007XR devices. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the startUpdateProcess method. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code in the context of root.
addtionnal_details:
Kenwood has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://www.kenwood.com/cs/ce/mm/firmware/2020/2020f/eng.html
